snippet.title: Nova Patria Playtesting Begins - Forge Your Roman Steampunk Colony
snippet.description:
Nova Patria is a simulation strategy game set in an alternate history where a steam-powered Roman Empire never fell, but instead ventured into the New World. As a colonial governor on the brink of an early industrial revolution, guide your colony’s technological path, expand horizons, and manage your burgeoning cities and resources within an isometric, procedurally generated Roman Steampunk world.

In this announcement, I’m excited to share that playtesting signups are officially open!
Playtesting kicks off on May 17th at 2pm EDT and will be hosted on the Sower Interactive Discord server.

How to Join:
1️⃣ Join our Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/jPsPvhMSYv
2️⃣ Sign up here: https://sowerinteractive.com/playtest/

We’re introducing a meta-game during playtesting, where players will compete week by week to accomplish in-game goals and out-score each other. Your feedback throughout playtesting will have a massive impact on Nova Patria's development, shaping its progression and refining its mechanics.

To stay up to date with development, make sure to subscribe to this channel to follow our devlog series where we track the game’s progression. Also, sign up for our mailing list to get notified when the Steam Page goes live and when Nova Patria officially launches.

📬 Sign up for the mailing list on our website: https://sowerinteractive.com/
💬 Join the community on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/jPsPvhMSYv
📝 Register for playtesting: https://sowerinteractive.com/playtest/
